correctness.rationale: A homomorphism from E_m to E_3 sends every source generator into the nilpotent augmentation ideal. Write each image uniquely as v_i in degree1, w_i in degree2 and t_i Omega in degree3. Over char!=2 the source anticommutativity and square-zero relations are equivalent to Phi V alternating; this includes zero diagonal and skew off-diagonal. If rank(V)=r with K=ker(V), an alternating Phi V descends uniquely to an alternating form on the r-dimensional quotient; Phi has m(3-r) additional extension degrees and cubic coefficients contribute m, giving an affine vector-bundle fiber of dimension m(4-r)+binom(r,2). Adding the rank-r matrix-stratum dimension r(3+m-r) gives d_r=4m+(5r-r²)/2. For m>=3 rank-2 and rank-3 irreducible strata have equal maximal dimension, with distinct closures since rank(V)<=2 is closed; thus at least two max-dimensional reduced components. In characteristic 2 E_3 is commutative and every augmentation element squares to zero; all m-tuples give affine A^(7m). Independently enumerated alternating-matrix fibers for m=1,2 over F3: m=2 ranks r=0,1,2 respectively 729,81,27 quadratic choices, exactly the formula.
residual_risks: Reduced variety only: no full component list or scheme-theoretic reducedness assertion, particularly near low-rank boundary.
